'''''Falcon''''' was a [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle/Legends|''Lambda''-class shuttle]] used by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]. When [[Shantipole Project]] was compromised by an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Spy/Legends|spy]] the project staff, [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gial Ackbar/Legends|Ackbar]], and the two prototype [[A/SF-01 B-wing starfighter/Legends|B-wings]] had to [[Battle of Roche (Galactic Civil War)|evacuate]]. The first prototype was unarmed but the second was and provided support. The ''Falcon'' was able to board the [[Research Station Shantipole|research station]], pick up Ackbar, and escape into [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] while the B-wing prototype, with help from some [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wings]], held off [[CR90 corvette/Legends|corvette]] group [[Javelin (corvette group)|''Javelin'']] and multiple [[Delta-class DX-9 stormtrooper transport|stormtrooper transports]] to allow the ''Shantipole'' to escape.
